blocks.html: Methods for managing and completing multi-factor authentication (MFA).

This method retrieves the MFA factors configured for the authenticated
identity. It sends a request to the
[List MFA Factors](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#auth\_getmfa\_factors)
API route.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description: The configured MFA factors.

children.name: mfa_factors
children.description: The MFA factors configured for the authenticated identity.

children.name: id
children.description: The multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration's ID.

children.name: auth_identity_id
children.description: The ID of the authentication identity this multi-factor authentication (MFA) belongs to.

children.name: auth_identity
children.description: The authentication identity this multi-factor authentication (MFA) belongs to.

children.name: provider
children.description: The multi-factor authentication (MFA) provider used.

children.name: status
children.description: The status of this multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Additional metadata for the multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration.

blocks.html:
This method starts MFA setup for the authenticated identity. It sends a
request to the
[Create MFA Factor](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#auth\_postmfa\_factors)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The MFA setup details.

children.name: provider
children.description: The MFA provider to set up.

children.name: label
children.description: Optional label for the MFA factor.

children.name: issuer
children.description:
Optional issuer name. For TOTP, authenticator apps show this as the
service name.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Optional metadata to store with the MFA factor.

blocks.html:
This method verifies an MFA challenge returned from `sdk.auth.login` or
`sdk.auth.callback`. It sends a request to the
[Verify MFA Challenge](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#auth\_postmfa\_challengesidverify)
API route.

If verification succeeds, the returned token is stored based on the SDK's
auth configuration, matching `sdk.auth.login`.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the MFA challenge to verify.

types.name: body
types.description: The challenge verification details.

children.name: method
children.description: The MFA challenge method used for verification.

children.name: code
children.description: The verification code for the selected challenge method.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description: The authentication JWT token.
